result.title: Collective Collaboration of Recursive Autonomous Agents
result.summary: Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operational mechanisms linking task decomposition, resource commitments, result aggregation, and coordination within the scope affected by change. A production network integrating machining, inspection, and logistics across multiple workshops illustrates how a common organizational kernel is instantiated at the equipment-service, workshop, and factory scales. The framework connects recursive organization with explicit task responsibilities, capability conditions, and execution interfaces for manufacturing systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向智能工厂，提出递归自主智能体（RAAs）的协同框架：以统一的任务与能力接口支持自顶向下的任务递归分解和自底向上的能力聚合，给出叶子单元与复合单元的组织模型、组合下的接口封闭性与有限任务展开条件，并在多车间制造网络中实例化。
AI.relevance_reason: 制造场景无视觉或学习机制，但其「接口封闭下的递归组合与条件能力聚合」形式化可能为 LVR 中分层任务分解、子推理单元组合与终止条件提供表述参照，是否可迁移需核查。
